youtube.title: The guillotine was named after a doctor who HATED it 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Dr. Guillotin wanted executions to be quick and equal. Then France named the machine after him 💀

Would YOU change your last name too? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Joseph-Ignace Guillotin proposed a quick, equal method of execution to the National Assembly in 1789, but the machine was designed by Dr. Antoine Louis and was first nicknamed "Louisette". Guillotin was NOT killed by it; he died in 1814. His family asked the government to rename the machine, was refused, and changed its own surname instead.
